entries.title: WinRunner contract work begins
entries.summary: Added the first controlled NT/WDM compatibility contracts, including typed WDM device and IRP foundations.

entries.title: Surface Pro 7 corpus restored
entries.summary: Added the extracted Surface MSI research corpus for hardware IDs, package relationships, and provenance analysis.

entries.title: Recovery, thermal, and distro documentation added
entries.summary: Established the evidence-first recovery path, conservative thermal policy, build stack, and professional documentation baseline.

entries.title: Native Android direction documented
entries.summary: Defined an optional AOSP/ART/Bionic/Binder userspace path with no Waydroid, Anbox, VM, or fake Pixel identity.

entries.title: Single-file ISO pipeline verified
entries.summary: Changed release delivery to one downloadable ISO artifact and published preview.4 build infrastructure.

entries.title: Find My bridge added
entries.summary: Added an optional OpenHaystack-compatible BLE beacon bridge with an explicit unaffiliated and non-certified boundary.

entries.title: Branding and VM audit completed
entries.summary: Added the validated NCOM white SVG source and converted VM feedback into documented asset and qualification requirements.

entries.title: Center onboarding and desktop theme shipped
entries.summary: Added the first-run GFYMS Center wizard, branded KDE theme package, and ISO package wiring.

entries.title: Qualify the next hardware boundary
entries.summary: Prioritize GFYMS-owned Surface platform, pen, Type Cover, sensor, audio, and IPU4 camera paths on real SP7 hardware.

entries.title: Advance WinRunner safely
entries.summary: Add MDL/DMA, PnP, power, interrupts, WDF contracts, and a controlled test DriverEntry boundary before any physical driver experiment.

entries.title: Build the optional Android proof of concept
entries.summary: Bring up a removable x86_64 AOSP userspace and validate Binder, ART, package installation, F-Droid, and hardware adapters independently.

entries.title: Harden release and recovery
entries.summary: Add signed reproducible releases, Secure Boot and UKI ownership guidance, bootable recovery media, and restore fixtures.
